title: Constrained Tree
statementMd:
You need to find a binary tree of size $*n*$ that satisfies a given set of $*c*$ constraints. Suppose that the nodes of the unknown binary tree are labeled using a *pre-order* traversal starting with $1$. For the $*i*$-th constraint you are given two labels, $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$ and a direction, left or right. In case of left direction, $*b*_{*i*}$ is an element of the subtree rooted at $*a*_{*i*}$'s left child. Similarly in the case of right direction $*b*_{*i*}$ is an element of the subtree rooted at $*a*_{*i*}$'s right child.

## Input

The first line of input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*c*$. The next $*c*$ lines contain 2 integers $*a*_{*i*}$, $*b*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$) and either "`LEFT`" or "`RIGHT`" denoting whether $*b*$ is in the subtree rooted at $*a*_{*i*}$'s left child or in the subtree rooted at $*a*_{*i*}$'s right child.

*The problem consists of multiple subproblems. The subproblems have different constraints on the input. You will get some score for the correct submission of the subproblem. The description of the subproblems follows.*

- In subproblem D1 ($9$ points), the constraints $1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$, $1 ≤ *c* ≤ 50$ will hold.
- In subproblem D2 ($8$ points), the constraints $1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000000$, $1 ≤ *c* ≤ 100000$ will hold.

## Output

Output will be on a single line.

Any binary tree that satisfies the constraints will be accepted. The tree's nodes should be printed out as $*n*$ space separated labels representing an *in-order* traversal, using the *pre-order* numbers as labels of vertices.

If there are no trees that satisfy the constraints, print "`IMPOSSIBLE`" (without quotes).

## Note

Consider the first sample test. We need to find a tree with 3 nodes that satisfies the following two constraints. The node labeled 2 with pre-order traversal should be in the left subtree of the node labeled 1 with pre-order traversal; the node labeled 3 with pre-order traversal should be in the right subtree of the node labeled 1. There is only one tree with three nodes that satisfies these constraints and its in-order traversal is $(2, 1, 3)$.

*Pre-order* is the "root – left subtree – right subtree" order. *In-order* is the "left subtree – root – right subtree" order.

For other information regarding *in-order* and *pre-order*, see [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tree_traversal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tree_traversal).

{"titleZh":"受约束的树","bodyZh":"你需要找到一棵大小为 $*n*$ 的二叉树，使其满足给定的 $*c*$ 个约束。假设未知二叉树的节点按照*先序*遍历进行标号，从 $1$ 开始。对于第 *i* 条约束，给定两个标签 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$，以及一个方向：左或右。如果方向为左，则 $*b*_{*i*}$ 是以 $*a*_{*i*}$ 的左孩子为根的子树中的一个节点；同样地，如果方向为右，则 $*b*_{*i*}$ 是以 $*a*_{*i*}$ 的右孩子为根的子树中的一个节点。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*c*$。接下来的 $*c*$ 行包含两个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$、$*b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$），以及 "`LEFT`" 或 "`RIGHT`"，表示 $*b*$ 位于以 $*a*_{*i*}$ 的左孩子为根的子树中，还是位于以 $*a*_{*i*}$ 的右孩子为根的子树中。

*本题由多个子问题组成。不同子问题对输入有不同的约束。提交正确的子问题解答将获得相应的分数。各子问题的描述如下。*

- 在子问题 D1（$9$ 分）中，保证满足 $1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$、$1 ≤ *c* ≤ 50$。
- 在子问题 D2（$8$ 分）中，保证满足 $1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000000$、$1 ≤ *c* ≤ 100000$。

## 输出格式

输出应为一行。

输出任意一棵满足约束的二叉树即可。应输出 $*n*$ 个以空格分隔的标签，表示该树的*中序*遍历，其中使用节点的*先序*编号作为标签。

如果不存在满足约束的树，则输出 "`IMPOSSIBLE`"（不含引号）。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。我们需要找到一棵包含 3 个节点的树，使其满足以下两个约束：先序遍历编号为 2 的节点应位于先序遍历编号为 1 的节点的左子树中；先序遍历编号为 3 的节点应位于先序遍历编号为 1 的节点的右子树中。满足这些约束的三节点树只有一棵，其中序遍历为 $(2, 1, 3)$。

*先序*遍历的顺序是“根 – 左子树 – 右子树”。*中序*遍历的顺序是“左子树 – 根 – 右子树”。

关于*中序*遍历和*先序*遍历的其他信息，请参见 [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tree_traversal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tree_traversal)。"}
